formulation: Discrete design selection with analytic sizing; maximize/minimize single objective subject to constraints; exhaustive enumeration of catalog product.
decision_variables: instrument subset (binary per instrument, at least one)
derived_variables: propellant mass (rocket equation with tank fraction)
science (min(1, downlink/generated) x sum of weights)
equations: m_prop = m_dry*(MR-1)/(1-tank_frac*(MR-1)); wet = dry + tank_frac*m_prop + m_prop
dry = (sum subsystems + structure_frac + thermal_frac + array + battery)*(1+MGA)
not_modeled: reliability / redundancy (no evidence-based reliability data collected)

solver.name: exhaustive enumeration
solver.settings: deterministic; Python implementation tools/opt_model.py; JavaScript port in docs/app.js

method_notes.why_not_LP_MILP: Sizing equations are nonlinear (exponential rocket equation, log link budget); the catalog is small enough for exact enumeration which also yields Pareto sets without solver assumptions.
